name: claude-auto-retry
description: Auto-continue Claude Code sessions after a usage-limit reset: detects the "limit reached" banner in tmux panes running claude, then either sends "continue" automatically after the reset (plus a configurable offset) or asks you first — with an abort/confirm toast either way. Also adds a CLAUDE USAGE panel showing token burn per 5-hour block, estimated from local transcripts.

claudeAutoRetry.mode.description: What to do when a Claude Code pane hits a usage limit. Off also stops the background pane polling entirely.

claudeAutoRetry.offsetMinutes.description: Minutes to wait after the limit resets before sending the continue message.

claudeAutoRetry.message.description: Text sent to the Claude Code pane to resume the session.
